decisions.reason: The same message independently establishes the cover page-number rule, which is already represented; the table-of-contents correction does not require an additional change to it.
Correcting table-of-contents page numbers does not change the policy for eliminating visible white space at article ends.
Table-of-contents pagination accuracy does not alter the required rendering sharpness of advertisements.
The table-of-contents correction does not change the selected article typeface or its readability constraint.
Final pagination may reflect included articles, but the source decision does not change which cover-listed articles must be included or who places them.
Requiring accurate table-of-contents page numbers does not modify two-page spread compatibility or layout-balance requirements.
The table-of-contents pagination correction does not change the tribute page's placement near the end of the magazine.
Table-of-contents accuracy has no necessary effect on the requirement to remediate article image quality.
Correcting table-of-contents page numbers does not change the magazine's polished, modern, brand-aligned visual style.
The pagination correction affects table-of-contents content but does not change the required digital flipbook deliverable.
The table-of-contents correction neither resumes nor modifies the deferred print-ready output requirement.
Accurate table-of-contents pagination does not change the specified source from which articles are obtained.
